account_contract.funding: actual Bybit settlements when available; adverse proxy before exact source
account_contract.liquidation: forced liquidation invalidates the selected account path
account_contract.position_sizing: NAV risk budget divided by structural stop loss per unit including costs

actions_and_orders.continuation_stop: back inside accepted level plus volatility buffer
actions_and_orders.entry: first causally observable marketable minute price after completed decision plus 500ms; with 1m OHLCV this is next-minute open
actions_and_orders.model: two HistGradientBoosting regressors for after-cost structural payoff, calibrated with monotone isotonic maps
actions_and_orders.rejection_stop: beyond sweep extreme plus volatility buffer

advance_or_kill.advance: positive non-liquidating 24bp calibration and untouched 2023H2 account freezes and opens official 2024H1 immediately
advance_or_kill.kill: negative, sub-cost, sparse or winner-concentrated pre-2024 account closes the exact route without adjacent rescue
advance_or_kill.ranking: insert any superior hard-valid account path immediately
advance_or_kill.risk_search: broad risk and leverage optimization only after positive base alpha

economic_thesis.continuation: Price obtains acceptance beyond external liquidity and continues after completed displacement/FVG structure.
economic_thesis.flat: No action when neither structural path has positive calibrated utility after stressed costs.
economic_thesis.payoff_scale: material intraday moves measured in fractions of a percent to several percent, not individual ticks
economic_thesis.rejection: A confirmed external-liquidity raid fails to obtain acceptance and rotates toward internal or opposing liquidity.

event_and_features.availability: all feature values end no later than the completed decision timestamp
event_and_features.confirmation: completed 5m displacement, failure and FVG geometry available by the 15m decision close
event_and_features.event: completed 15m crossing/sweep of a previously available external-liquidity level

forbidden_inputs: raw trades or quotes used as signal rows
liquidity_levels: confirmed 1h swing high/low after two right-side bars

market_scope.optional_symbol_admission: pre-2024 combined-account opportunity, growth and stability improvement

objective: Discover and causally validate a machine-learning SMC/ICT day-trading system on Bybit USDT linear perpetuals that captures minute-to-hour liquidity-auction moves after costs, without tick-by-tick, subsecond or queue-position alpha.

training_and_updates.activation: new model activates only after fit and calibration complete; prior model remains active until then
training_and_updates.retraining: expanding-window monthly refit using data available through the prior UTC month

user_scope.intended_holding_scale: minutes to hours; no forced minimum and no elapsed-time liquidation
user_scope.latency_role: causal activation assumption only; never optimized or used as alpha
